name: start-page-new-tab
description: Chrome extension that replaces the new tab page with a local-first start page.

scripts.check: for f in src/*.js tests/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('manifest.json','utf8'))"
scripts.pack: mkdir -p dist && rm -f dist/start-page.zip && zip -r dist/start-page.zip manifest.json newtab.html src styles fonts icons
